## Notes

- Job description and write paths: `references/lanes/skills.md`; content writes only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` / `label-write.mjs` / `issue-create.mjs` / `close-cards.mjs` and `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --actions-file`; route `dispatch` (relay `fleet-write.yml` on `main`); ⛔ no MCP write. Landing shapes: r172's Notes stand; measured this shift — the seat's `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` in one dispatch → `added_to_merge_queue` 1.5–2.5 min later → MERGED 25–35 min later on three PRs (#22656, #22684, #22686); `check-governed-merges --pr N` exit 3 is the GOVERNED Tier S verdict, not an error; `check-expected-skips.mjs` needs the `yaml` package outside the checkout.
- Harness: **STALE** against `origin/main` by two landed `.claude/**` changes of this seat's own (PR #22684's `platform-readings.md`; PR #22686's `os-dev.md` and `execution-duties.md`); the shared checkout stays at `5e231a08b` until the seat's sign-off boundary (no dispatch before then), where `git pull --ff-only origin main` picks them up; the mirror branch `claude/bold-cray-0a9zgb` follows. `check:platform-checklist` is red on `origin/main` (the watchdog's; anchor #22594 closed `not_planned`), not a landing blocker.
- Platform readings this shift: the auto-mode classifier's verdict on an identical `label-write … --add skip-changeset --assign marchtian` stroke — refused ×1 (PR #22654's dev), passed ×3 (PR #22684's, #22686's, #22691/#22692's devs); the dev-side `dispatch.mjs --actions-file` stroke refused ×0 — the reason #22467 took option B. `post-stamped` refuses a body mixing `{{NOW}}` with bare stamps (every reading of another event is `{{WAS:…}}`), refuses a `Claim:` whose `Container & model:` line names the ceiling tier without the `--tier` MANDATORY citation on the same line, and knocks on unread comments before a `--body` refresh (`--ack-through=ID`); a PR body edit through `post-stamped --body=PR` lands as `issue_patch` and fires `pull_request.edited`, which re-judges the closing-target claim guard; the egress proxy denies the Actions log-download host, so a failing job's log is read by reproducing it, not by fetching it; the harness's built-in check refuses a `bash -c "$cmd"` gate-runner loop (not the classifier).
- Timers and subscriptions: patrol Routine `trig_01Ev9WzaBhY6VZCmKof8guPh` (three fires during the second wall were delivered together at 17:41Z); no one-shot; `subscribe_pr_activity` live on PR #22691 and PR #22692 (the watches on #22650, #22654, #22684 and #22686 ended at their merges); every dev is a `mode:subagent` in this session.
